verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a priority service tier that explicitly promises faster time-to-first-token and higher throughput, which is direct support for latency-sensitive serving. That benefit is framed only relative to peak demand and limited to supported models, and no latency or throughput figures are given. Dedicated autoscaling GPU instances are documented, but nothing ties them to latency guarantees. missing for 10: published TTFT/throughput benchmarks or latency SLAs, independent or hands-on corroboration of speed, documentation of baseline (non-peak, non-priority) latency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve latency-sensitive workloads with fast time-to-first-token and high-throughput generation

citations.quote: Set service_tier to "priority" to request priority inference on supported models. Priority requests get faster time-to-first-token and higher throughput during peak demand.
Deploy a dedicated instance on A100/H100/H200/B200/B300 with autoscaling and a private endpoint
